title: Ledger Accounting Note: Start Date of the Interest Period Closed by a Whole Life Insurance Anniversary Capitalization
content:
For an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the interest period that an anniversary capitalization closes starts on a date the policy ledger fixes.

## Rule

1. Where the latest loan repayment on the ledger paid loan interest, falls on or before the anniversary, is later than the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy, and is no earlier than the anniversary of the latest capitalization entry, the period starts on that repayment's date, because the repayment settled interest up to its own date. Where the ledger has no capitalization entry, the last of these conditions is met.
2. Otherwise, where the anniversary of the latest capitalization entry is later than the loan interest paid-to date shown, the period starts on that anniversary.
3. Otherwise the period starts on the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy.

A repayment paid loan interest when its entry shows an interest amount above zero. The anniversary of a capitalization entry is the anniversary closing the interest year it capitalized.

## Inputs

- The latest loan repayment entry on the activity history: its date and the interest it included.
- The latest capitalization entry: the anniversary it closed.
- The loan interest paid-to date on the policy record.

## Truth table (anniversary closing the period: September 1, 2025)

| Latest repayment | Repayment paid interest | Latest capitalization anniversary | Loan interest paid-to date shown | Period starts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| March 3, 2025 | Yes | September 1, 2024 | September 1, 2023 | March 3, 2025 |
| March 3, 2025 | No | September 1, 2024 | September 1, 2023 | September 1, 2024 |
| July 15, 2024 | Yes | September 1, 2024 | September 1, 2023 | September 1, 2024 (the repayment is earlier than the capitalization anniversary) |
| None | | None | September 1, 2024 | September 1, 2024 |
| March 3, 2025 | Yes | None | September 1, 2024 | March 3, 2025 |
| October 2, 2025 | Yes | None | September 1, 2024 | September 1, 2024 (the repayment falls after the anniversary) |
